name: Creative Writing
description: Stories, scripts, lyrics, articles: voice, plot and revision.
note: This is a creative writing project. Keep the established voice, names, facts and timeline consistent across chats, ask before changing a character or plot point, and offer revisions as alternatives rather than silent rewrites.
details: For fiction, scripts, lyrics, essays and articles, where voice and continuity matter more than anything else. The agent keeps names, facts and the timeline consistent across all the chats of the project, asks before changing a character or a rule you established, and revises what exists instead of rewriting it. The Creative writing tool reads the manuscript: statistics per chapter, repeated phrases and tics with their lines, and names spelled almost the same (Catherine and Katherine). It points at places to look; you decide.
examples: A novel, one chat per chapter, with a character sheet in the Library
Song lyrics in a fixed rhyme scheme and meter
A newsletter series that must sound like one author
Screenplay scenes that follow an outline

tools.why: statistics, repeated phrases and tics, name and spelling slips across chapters
